craft_notes: Sthāyin: vīra of joined debate — Sāṅkhya fairly stated then page-turned. Conditional close; deemed-mover kept. Rejected: (a) closing unconditionally → killed: conditional is the hinge to p04. Read aloud: IF-pur-POSED for-SPIR-it … PRIM-al-STUFF is-DEEMED its-MOV-er.

lines: If purposed for spirit in every act it works —
primal stuff is deemed its mover.

reads_against.argmap: What is conceived? → Conditional close: puruṣārtha-natured acts conceived efficient by pradhāna.
c1_essence: Sāṅkhya stated at full strength: pradhāna proved by presence, purposed by denying self-aims; change easy; only striving moves; nature faces down (vv19-22).
The page turns on admitted karma: where is His business? Let His triggering be conceived; seed imaged; Sāṅkhya godless; conditional close (vv23-27).
